description: [GA4 WRITE] Update a custom metric (parameterName and scope are immutable). Pass only the fields to change; updateMask is derived from them (override with an explicit updateMask for nested paths). Requires GA4_MCP_ENABLE_WRITES=true and confirm=true.

confirm.description: Must be true to apply the change.

name.description: Full resource name of the custom metric to target: "properties/{property}/customMetrics/{id}".

updateMask.description: Comma-separated field paths to update. Omit to derive from the supplied fields.

name: ga4_update_custom_metric
